2609.10155.title: From Retrieval to Weights: Parametric Individualization of Small Language Models with Individual Text Corpora
2609.10155.paper_summary: We approach a cognitive simulation perspective on episodic and semantic memory in multiple-choice question answering by incorporating text from individual text corpora (ITC) into retrieval-augmented generation and DoRA fine-tuning. We web-crawl the search histories of 515 participants who answered 36 multiple-choice knowledge items and analyze a stratified subsample of 150 participants. For each participant, one DoRA adapter consolidates their ITC into a small language model (SLM) whose baseline correctness falls below the participants' lowest quartile. The adapter measurably writes the ITC into the weights: it fits its own participant's held-out text better than other participants' texts (dz =1.27), an individuality effect that increases with ITC size in rank order. On the generalized knowledge test, however, the adapter adds knowledge rather than alignment with the individual: log-loss match improves, whereas match accuracy under a bias-corrected PMI readout does not, and retrieval adds nothing on top. Our results demonstrate that ITCs can be consolidated into the weights of SLMs, an encouraging basis for individualized tutoring agents, and we discuss how to move from there toward a realistic simulation of episodic and semantic memory at the individual level.
2609.10155.paper_summary_zh: 我們從認知模擬的角度探討在多選題回答中情節記憶和語義記憶的關係，通過將個別文本語料庫（ITC）的文本納入檢索增強生成和DoRA微調。我們對515名參與者的搜索歷史進行了網絡爬蟲，這些參與者回答了36個多選知識項目，並分析了150名參與者的分層子樣本。對於每位參與者，一個DoRA適配器將他們的ITC整合到一個小型語言模型（SLM）中，其基線正確率低於參與者的最低四分位數。該適配器可測量地將ITC寫入權重：它比其他參與者的文本更好地擬合自己參與者的保留文本（dz =1.27），這是一種隨著ITC大小按排名順序增加的個體性效應。然而，在一般知識測試中，該適配器添加的是知識，而不是與個體的對齊：對數損失匹配有所改善，而在偏差修正的PMI讀取下的匹配準確性則沒有改善，檢索也沒有額外的增益。我們的結果顯示，ITC可以整合到SLM的權重中，這為個性化輔導代理提供了令人鼓舞的基礎，我們討論了如何從這裡向個體層面現實模擬情節和語義記憶邁進。
